## Claims
- [source-backed] Partition conjugation is a ring involution \(\omega(s_\lambda)=s_{\lambda'}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 484-485]
- [proved] With \(q=n-r\), \(\lambda\subseteq q^r\iff\lambda'\subseteq r^q\); hence \(\omega(I_{r,q})=I_{q,r}\) and \(\omega:\Lambda/I_{r,q}\xrightarrow{\sim}\Lambda/I_{q,r}\) is a graded integral algebra isomorphism. This is claim-3.
- [proved] The requested claim-4 would additionally require
  \[
  \omega(J_v)=J_{v^\vee},\qquad
  \omega(A_{r,q,+}J_v)=A_{q,r,+}J_{v^\vee},
  \]
  for \(v^\vee=v_{q,q+j-i,q-i+1,n}\), to induce
  \[
  J_v/A_{r,q,+}J_v\cong J_{v^\vee}/A_{q,r,+}J_{v^\vee}.
  \]
  The audited attempt assumes, rather than establishes, the needed interval identity
  \[
  J_v=\bigoplus_{i^j\subseteq\lambda\subseteq q^r}\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda.
  \]
  Its cited source establishes only the lower-adjoined minimal generating family; the right-adjoined family is stated as requiring a transposed argument. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 827-840; artifact 303bb71e6126b3dc44d46d06a67a689ee5ac50b7a68bbff58cbe43e2d8119a49, L1-L96]
- [proved] This gap remains for \(a=0\), \(i=q\), \(j=r\), \(i-b=0\), and \(j-b=0\): although the auxiliary families
  \[
  G_L=\{\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}:\rho\subseteq b^a\},\qquad
  G_R=\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}
  \]
  may collapse, the required ideal equalities above were not supplied.
- [proved] No finite \(G_L\)-to-\(G_R\) transition computation was run: the audited record supplies no parameter instance, ordered bases, transition matrix, determinant, Smith data, or task-owned computation artifact. [artifact 303bb71e6126b3dc44d46d06a67a689ee5ac50b7a68bbff58cbe43e2d8119a49, L1-L96]

## Strategy
The quotient-ring conjugation is verified, but restriction to the two basic ideals is an additional required equality. Since that equality is only assumed in the audited attempt, the audit stops at claim-3.

## Gaps
The interval description of \(J_v\), its conjugate identification with \(J_{v^\vee}\), and the induced quotient equality are missing from this audited record.

## Next
The certificate is established: the audit therefore must stop at claim-3, not claim-4. The requested quotient-conjugation target was not established. No finite \(G_L\)-to-\(G_R\) transition computation was run.
